method: Make the filling first. Slice the boiled eggs and keep them chilled until assembly, or warm them gently if this dish is being served hot.

Keep the lettuce, tomato and other fresh/crunchy ingredients out of the pan. Season the boiled eggs with the measured flavourings and keep the fresh ingredients fresh; there is no sauce reduction step to invent here.
Warm the wrap, then layer the filling through the centre with the fresh/crunchy elements last. Do not overfill it just because you can.
Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes if you want a crisp finish.
